+def _extract_thinking_tokens(usage: Any) -> int:
+    """Return usage.output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens (0 if absent or null)."""
+    details = getattr(usage, "output_tokens_details", None)
+    thinking = getattr(details, "thinking_tokens", None)
+    if isinstance(thinking, int) and not isinstance(thinking, bool):
+        return thinking
+    return 0
+

+def anthropic_stream_with_thinking_tokens():
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    events = anthropic_stream_with_server_tool_usage()
+    events[1] = SimpleNamespace(
+        type="message_delta",
+        delta=events[1].delta,
+        usage=SimpleNamespace(
+            input_tokens=10,
+            output_tokens=110,
+            cache_creation_input_tokens=0,
+            cache_read_input_tokens=0,
+            server_tool_use=None,
+            output_tokens_details=SimpleNamespace(thinking_tokens=40),
+        ),
+    )
+    return events
+
+
+def test_streaming_reports_thinking_tokens_as_reasoning_tokens(mock_client):
+    with patch(
+        "anthropic.resources.Messages.create",
+        return_value=iter(anthropic_stream_with_thinking_tokens()),
+    ):
+        client = Anthropic(api_key="test-key", posthog_client=mock_client)
+        response = client.messages.create(
+            model="claude-haiku-4-5",
+            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
+            stream=True,
+        )
+        list(response)
+
+    props = mock_client.capture.call_args.kwargs["properties"]
+    assert props["$ai_output_tokens"] == 110
+    assert props["$ai_reasoning_tokens"] == 40
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_streaming_reports_thinking_tokens_as_reasoning_tokens_async(
+    mock_client,
+):
+    async def mock_async_stream():
+        for event in anthropic_stream_with_thinking_tokens():
+            yield event
+
+    async def mock_async_create(**kwargs):
+        return mock_async_stream()
+
+    with patch(
+        "anthropic.resources.messages.AsyncMessages.create",
+        side_effect=mock_async_create,
+    ):
+        client = AsyncAnthropic(api_key="test-key", posthog_client=mock_client)
+        response = await client.messages.create(
+            model="claude-haiku-4-5",
+            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
+            stream=True,
+        )
+        [event async for event in response]
+
+    props = mock_client.capture.call_args.kwargs["properties"]
+    assert props["$ai_reasoning_tokens"] == 40
+
+

+def test_response_usage_maps_thinking_tokens_to_reasoning_tokens():
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    from posthog.ai.anthropic.anthropic_converter import (
+        extract_anthropic_usage_from_response,
+    )
+
+    response = SimpleNamespace(
+        usage=SimpleNamespace(
+            input_tokens=10,
+            output_tokens=50,
+            output_tokens_details=SimpleNamespace(thinking_tokens=30),
+        ),
+        content=[],
+    )
+    usage = extract_anthropic_usage_from_response(response)
+    assert usage["output_tokens"] == 50
+    assert usage["reasoning_tokens"] == 30
+

+def test_response_usage_null_output_tokens_details_is_absent():

+def test_stream_message_delta_thinking_tokens_not_double_counted():
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    from posthog.ai.anthropic._anthropic_stream import _AnthropicStreamAccumulator
+
+    acc = _AnthropicStreamAccumulator()
+    for output, thinking in [(20, 10), (50, 30)]:
+        acc.consume(
+            SimpleNamespace(
+                type="message_delta",
+                usage=SimpleNamespace(
+                    output_tokens=output,
+                    output_tokens_details=SimpleNamespace(thinking_tokens=thinking),
+                ),
+            )
+        )
+    assert acc.usage_stats["output_tokens"] == 50
+    assert acc.usage_stats["reasoning_tokens"] == 30
